claims: No. 5 seed Michigan State defeated No. 12 seed Colorado State 65-62 in a 2026 Women's NCAA Tournament first-round game.
Grace VanSlooten scored 18 points for Michigan State.
Kennedy Blair scored 18 points for Michigan State.
Brooke Carlson scored 26 points for Colorado State.
The game was played on March 20, 2026, in Norman, Oklahoma, at the University of Oklahoma.
Colorado State held a 29-27 halftime lead.
Michigan State took the lead for good on a 3-pointer by Jalyn Brown with 9:01 remaining.
Grace VanSlooten had 10 rebounds for Michigan State.
Brooke Carlson had 6 rebounds for Colorado State.
Michigan State advances to the second round for the second consecutive season.
The game was the second meeting between Michigan State and Colorado State.
Michigan State defeated Colorado State in 2011.
Michigan State advances to face the winner of No. 4 Oklahoma and No. 13 Idaho.
